audio.strategy: Hybrid, and declared per source. Grand, Upright and Electric play bundled *recordings* (three separate licensed sample sets loaded from the bundle). Clav, Digital and Misc are modelled additive synthesis. The Organ and Synth engines are live *synthesis* with no sample content at all: organ registrations are rendered to looped buffers from harmonic partial tables, and synth notes are rendered sample-by-sample from the oscillator, filter, envelope and LFO generators. Reverb impulse responses are generated at runtime; no recorded IRs are bundled. Every source is declared below, and no generated buffer is described as a recording.
signalOrder: Amp Sim / EQ (or LP24/HP24 filter, or To Rotary)
Shared Rotary (only when the layer is routed via To Rotary; always last)
audio.limiter: DynamicsCompressor at -1.5 dBFS threshold, 0 dB knee, 20:1 ratio, 2 ms attack, 120 ms release, ceiling 0.96

generatedSources.name: Modelled piano body (Grand/Upright/Electric asset-failure fallback)
generatedSources.description: Deterministic additive synthesis used only when a recorded set fails to load. Up to 24 stretched partials with per-partial inharmonicity and decay, a deterministic hammer transient, velocity-dependent brightness, and a per-note damper release. This is never presented as a recording: the display reports 'Piano not found' and the library status reports state=fallback.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate. No third-party samples, IRs or impulse responses.

generatedSources.name: Clav (modelled)
generatedSources.description: The additive model with a clavinet character: a fast exponential decay and an added third-harmonic transient for the plucked bite. Declared 'modelled' in the model catalogue and printed as 'Clav D6 (modelled)' in the display.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Digital (modelled)
generatedSources.description: The additive model with a clean digital-piano character: a gentle high roll-off, a slightly longer sustain and no hammer noise.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Misc mallet (modelled)
generatedSources.description: The additive model with a marimba/vibraphone character: a hard fast decay plus strong 4x and 7x partials.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Reverb impulse responses
generatedSources.description: Six generated impulse responses (Room, Booth, Spring, Stage, Hall, Cathedral) built from a deterministic PRNG: a pre-delay, early reflections and an exponential noise tail whose length comes from the type's declared decay. Spring additionally has five dispersive taps. No recorded IRs are used.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Amp / cabinet / drive curves
generatedSources.description: A fixed tanh soft-clip transfer curve shared by every saturator (drive is applied as input gain), plus a transparent-below-the-knee output ceiling curve. The Twin, JC and Small models are documented approximations built from a tone stack and cabinet corner frequencies, not measured impulse responses.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Organ tonewheel registration (B3)
generatedSources.description: Looped buffer rendered from nine sine partials at the tonewheel footage intervals, each with a low-level octave and twelfth leakage. No sample content.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Organ transistor registration (Vox)
generatedSources.description: Seven reedy partials through a fixed formant, plus a filtered/unfiltered mix drawbar and a squared divider component. No sample content.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Organ register-sum registration (Farf)
generatedSources.description: Nine on/off register selectors, each contributing its own voice character (flute, oboe, trumpet, string) as a harmonic series. No sample content.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Organ pipe registration (Pipe 1 and Pipe 2)
generatedSources.description: Nine principal ranks, each a full harmonic series; Pipe 2 uses a brighter weighting of the same ranks. No sample content.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: B3 percussion and key click
generatedSources.description: A single decaying envelope over the 2nd or 3rd harmonic for percussion, and a seeded short noise burst for the key click. Both generated at note on.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Synth oscillators
generatedSources.description: Pure shapes from band-limited single-cycle tables; a hard-synced oscillator; three- and six-saw Multi stacks; a seven-voice Super stack with spread panning; and a two-operator FM algorithm. No sample content.
generatedSources.licence: Original work authored for this candidate.

generatedSources.name: Synth filter, envelopes and LFO
generatedSources.description: RBJ biquad coefficients for LP12/LP24/HP/BP with per-sample cutoff modulation, AD/AR envelopes, tanh drive, and five LFO waveforms including a seeded Sample & Hold. No sample content.

notes: Recorded and modelled sources are never mixed silently: the model catalogue declares each model's source, the Program display prints 'recorded' only for the three sample sets, and the library chip reports SAMPLES READY, LOADING SAMPLES, MODELLED or PIANO NOT FOUND.

Root notes and velocity layers are per file in src/audio/sample-manifest.json, which also marks every file as kind=recorded or kind=derived (a derived file is a re-pitched copy of a stated source root, used only to fill a gap wider than four semitones).

Per-file level trims live in src/audio/sample-gains.json. They are gains only — no EQ, compression or other tone shaping — measured from each file's own loudness so a quiet ppp layer is audible while the layer ordering stays natural.
Polyphony is 16 voices per layer with deterministic oldest-first stealing; each layer steals independently.
Sustain is a real per-layer route: SUSTPED decides whether the pedal holds that layer's notes, and lift damps exactly the layers it was holding.
Only the sustain pedal is implemented. Soft pedal, sostenuto and half-pedaling are deliberately not claimed, and MIDI CC66/CC67 are ignored rather than silently mapped.
Every audible parameter change uses a short ramp (setTargetAtTime, ~12-20 ms), and unit bypass is a crossfaded gain pair rather than a disconnect, so switching never clicks.

The chain output has a soft ceiling so panel EQ boosts (+/-15 dB) cannot leave a chain above full scale; below that knee the stage is transparent, and the master limiter remains the only stage that acts on normal playing.

The Organ and Synth engines contain no recorded audio. Their buffers are rendered at runtime from the tables and generators in src/audio/organModel.ts and src/audio/synthModel.ts, and are described as synthesis everywhere.
Every rendered organ registration is a seamless whole-cycle loop whose pitch is corrected by the source's playback rate, so the played note is in tune rather than a few cents sharp.

Synth voices are rendered to a buffer and played as one source. The array the browser plays is the array the tests measure, which is why the filter, envelope and LFO claims are asserted sample-for-sample.
The arpeggiator steps on an injected clock, so a fixed tempo and note set produce a deterministic sequence in the tests.
Master Level is a performance control and is deliberately absent from the program state, so a program change neither stores nor restores it.

engineScope.note: Both Organ layers share the one `organ` chain, exactly as specs/nord-stage-4.effects.json `routing.chains` describes. Piano A/B and Synth A/B/C each own a chain.

boundaries.audio: src/audio/types.ts declares the minimal Web Audio surface (including the Phase 2 node types); src/audio/webAudioEngine.ts owns the single context, the two layer chains, the shared rotary and the master path; src/audio/adapters.ts adapts the platform AudioContext node by node, including connecting to AudioParams; src/audio/fakes.ts provides a recording fake context and engine for state-level tests.
boundaries.effects: src/audio/effectTypes.ts is the single source of truth for type lists, ranges and parameter mappings; src/audio/effectState.ts holds the per-layer chains plus focus/group/global/bypass; src/audio/effectGraph.ts builds and updates the DSP; src/audio/panelBindings.ts maps catalog control ids onto that state so the panel and the graph cannot disagree.
boundaries.samples: src/audio/pianoVoice.ts resolves a note to a root and velocity layer, loads and caches the decoded buffer, and builds the voice. Loading is injected through fetchBytes so a failed or slow library can be tested without a network.
boundaries.midi: src/input/midi.ts declares MidiAccessLike/MidiInputLike and the bridge; adapters.ts adapts the platform MIDIAccess; tests drive plain objects with no device.
boundaries.timing: src/audio/clock.ts declares a Clock interface with a system implementation and a manual implementation for tests.
boundaries.injection: src/instrument/useInstrument.ts accepts InstrumentDeps (engine, createAudioContext, requestMidiAccess, clock, disableAudio, sampleBaseUrl, fetchSampleBytes, initialState). Nothing in the app reaches for a global without going through it.
boundaries.measurement: harness.html + src/harness/main.ts import the production audio modules and expose them for the evidence capture, so evidence is measured on the shipped DSP rather than a copy. The page has no UI and is not part of the instrument.
boundaries.organ: src/audio/organModel.ts is the single source of truth for the six organ models and their registrations; src/audio/organVoice.ts turns a registration into a looped buffer plus percussion and key-click one-shots; src/audio/organState.ts holds the two layers' state. The same functions render in the browser, in the offline renderer and in the tests.
boundaries.synth: src/audio/synthModel.ts holds the waveform list, oscillator generators, filter coefficients, envelopes, LFO, voice-mode rules and the arpeggiator planner; src/audio/synthVoice.ts renders a note to a buffer; src/audio/synthState.ts holds the three layers' state.
boundaries.programs: src/audio/programState.ts is the canonical serializable state and its pure helpers (zones, crossfades, scenes, morphs, clock); src/audio/programStore.ts implements the 32-slot bank, the Live slots, Store/Store As, the dirty lifecycle and the injectable persistence boundary. The program system reads and writes the instrument's live state rather than holding a copy.
boundaries.bindings: src/audio/panelBindings.ts is the one place that decides what each catalog control does. It holds the functional binding table and the unsupported table, and `auditControls()` reports any control that is in neither.

functional: Piano section: six types, eight models, two layers with enable/focus/level/octave/zones, KB Touch, Dyn Comp, Timbre, Unison, Soft Release, String Res, SUSTPED, Master Level
Three bundled recorded sample sets (Grand, Upright, Electric) with real root notes and 3-4 velocity layers

Organ section: two layers, six models over four required-distinct engines (B3, Vox, Farf, Pipe 1) plus B3 Bass and Pipe 2 reusing them, nine drawbars per layer, B3 percussion, key click, six vibrato/chorus settings, per-layer SUSTPED and PSTICK, octave shift

Synth section: three layers, the exact required waveform list in five categories, category-correct Osc Ctrl, LP12/LP24/HP/BP filters with tracking/resonance/drive, three envelopes, a five-waveform LFO with three destinations, poly/mono/legato with priority, glide, unison and vibrato, and a deterministic arpeggiator/gate
Layer Effects for all six chains: Mod 1 (6 types), Mod 2 (6 types), Delay (with feedback filtering and ping-pong), Amp Sim/EQ (7 models), Compressor, Reverb (6 types), plus the one shared Rotary

FX focus following the focused layer across all three sections, the seven manual focus buttons, Piano group mode, Delay/Compressor/Reverb global mode, per-unit bypass and the Layer Effects ON all-effects bypass

Program section: 32 slots in 4 pages of 8 with factory content, the program dial and numeric list view, Store and Store As with naming, a computed dirty indicator, edit-discard on program change, a single-level undo, and 8 auto-storing Live slots
Splits: three editable points at the eleven documented positions, up to four zones, per-layer zone assignment, and Off/±6/±12 crossfades
Layer Scenes I/II, Wheel and Control Pedal morphs with assignment, interpolation, indicators and clearing
Master Clock (tap and dial) with its four sync targets, Transpose ±6, and Panic
Sustain from the on-screen pedal, the space bar and MIDI CC64 routed per layer by SUSTPED, plus MIDI CC11 driving the Control Pedal morph source
Truthful piano library status and a labelled, playable modelled fallback
decorativeOnly: Aux KB routing on both Organ layers (an Extern/Aux KB feature the programs spec excludes)
The Organ preset library, drawbar sync and the Organ's dedicated MORPH button
The Piano INFO view and PED NOISE switch
The Synth Samples/Extern mode selector, its pitch/tuning page switch and the arpeggiator PATTERN button
The three per-section preset library buttons and the A.T. morph source
Per-type Variations on Mod 1, Mod 2 and Reverb, the rotary close-mic switch and the rotary stop-angle switch
notImplementedAndLabelled: Aftertouch: not claimed as an input, because browser keyboards have none. The A.T. morph source and the A.T. vibrato mode exist and are listed as unsupported.
The Organ preset library and drawbar sync: excluded benchmark-wide and by the organ spec.
The per-section preset library and the 512-program factory bank: cut to one bank of 32 programs by the programs spec.
Num Pad mode, Monitor/Copy/Paste/Swap, Section Edit, Layer Init, Aux KB, Extern, memory protection and every Shift-menu: excluded by the programs spec.
External MIDI clock sync and pedal tap: excluded by the programs spec.
Soft pedal, sostenuto, half-pedaling, pedal noise, triple-pedal modelling and piano size classes: not implemented and not claimed.
Arpeggiator pattern editing, zig-zag, accent, pan and per-layer KB Hold exclude: excluded by the synth spec.
